notes_for_editor: Build year and builder are not in any source read. The 1953 date is from a caption on the Indiana Fire Towers page that says the tower is in the Rome topo of 1953; it shows the tower on the map but does not give a build date. The Forest Service list places German Ridge in its Forest Service section but does not show which district heading it sits under, so the story names no district. The search summary's claim that the Forest Service page files it under Indiana DNR is not supported by the page text we read, and the story does not repeat it. The 2018 report title is now confirmed from the cached PDF as '2018 Indiana Chapter Annual Report'; the widow quote sits in its 2019 plan of work. A search summary mentioned a German Ridge campground with 20 sites; not verified, not used. Nothing in the sources gives a removal date. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story now reads the widow quote as part of the 2019 plan of work, not as a 2018 statement, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list is named correctly.
